about: Scott G. Hawkins attended law school and graduated from University of Florida Levin College of Law in 1985. Scott Hawkins began practicing law in 1985.
Scott Hawkins is an attorney at Jones Foster P.A., helping people with Business Litigation issues. Jones Foster P.A. has an office in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving the local community.

Scott Hawkins was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
